# Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India

> Official website of the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi. Visa applications, consular services, and BiH-India bilateral relations.

The Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi serves the Bosnian community in India and supports diplomatic, consular, trade, and cultural relations between Bosnia and Herzegovina and India.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Embassy overview, announcements, and quick links to services.
- [About Bosnia and Herzegovina](/about): Country profile — history, culture, geography, and bilateral relations with India.
- [Consular Services](/services): Visa applications, document legalisation, passport services, civil registration, and trade facilitation.
- [Visa Requirements](/requirements): Documents and eligibility for tourist, business, student, and work visas.
- [Apply for a Visa](/apply): Online visa application form.
- [Track Your Application](/track): Check visa application status with passport number and date of birth.
- [Contact Us](/contact): Embassy address, phone, fax, email, office hours, and contact form.
